ayahs.1: These opening letters—known as the muqatta'at—are among the signs whose full meaning Allah kept with Himself. They open the surah by reminding the reader that this Book is from beyond human authorship: approach it with humility, not arrogance.
ayahs.2: By the clear Book—a scripture whose meaning is plain and whose guidance is unmistakable.
ayahs.3: We have made it a Quran in Arabic so perhaps you will understand.
ayahs.4: It is—in the Master Record with Us—highly esteemed, rich in wisdom.
ayahs.5: Should We then turn the Reminder away from you simply because you have been a transgressing people?
ayahs.6: Consider how many prophets We sent to those destroyed before!
ayahs.7: But no prophet ever came to them without being mocked.
ayahs.8: So We destroyed those who were far mightier than these Meccans. The examples of their predecessors have already been related.
ayahs.9: If you ask them who created the heavens and the earth, they will certainly say, "The Almighty, All-Knowing did."
ayahs.10: He is the One who laid out the earth for you and set pathways in it so you may find your way.
ayahs.11: He is the One who sends down rain from the sky in perfect measure, with which We give life to a lifeless land. And so will you be brought forth from the grave.
ayahs.12: He is the One who created all things in pairs and made for you ships and animals to ride
ayahs.13: so you may sit firmly on their backs and remember your Lord's blessings once settled on them, saying, "Glory be to the One who subjected these for us, for we could never have done so on our own.
ayahs.14: And surely to our Lord we will all return."
ayahs.15: Still the pagans have made some of His creation out to be a part of Him. Indeed, humankind is clearly ungrateful.
ayahs.16: Has He taken angels as daughters from what He created, while favouring you pagans with sons?
ayahs.17: Whenever one of them is given news of what they attribute to the Rahman—the mercy that encompasses all creation in this life—his face grows gloomy as he suppresses his rage.
ayahs.18: Do they attribute to Him those brought up in fineries who are not commanding in disputes?
ayahs.19: Still they have labelled the angels, who are servants of the Rahman, as female. Did they witness their creation? Their statement will be recorded, and they will be questioned!
ayahs.20: They argue: "Had the Rahman willed, we would never have worshipped them." They have no knowledge to support this claim. They do nothing but lie.
ayahs.21: Or have We given them a Book before this Quran to which they are holding firm?
ayahs.22: In fact they say: "We found our forefathers following a particular way, and we are following in their footsteps."
ayahs.23: Similarly, whenever We sent a warner to a society before you, its elite would say: "We found our forefathers following a particular way, and we are walking in their footsteps."
ayahs.24: Each warner asked: "Even if what I brought you is better guidance than what you found your forefathers practicing?" They replied: "We totally reject whatever you have been sent with."
ayahs.25: So We inflicted punishment upon them. See then what was the fate of those who deny the truth!
ayahs.26: Remember when Ibrahim declared to his father and his people: "I am totally free of whatever gods you worship,
ayahs.27: except the One who originated me, and He will surely guide me."
ayahs.28: He left this enduring declaration among his descendants, so they may always turn back to Allah.
ayahs.29: I had allowed enjoyment for these Meccans and their forefathers until the truth came to them along with a messenger making things clear.
ayahs.30: When the truth came to them, they said: "This is magic, and we totally reject it."
ayahs.31: They exclaimed: "If only this Quran was revealed to a great man from one of the two cities!"
ayahs.32: Is it they who distribute your Lord's mercy? We alone have distributed their livelihood among them in this dunya and raised some in rank above others so some may employ others in service. But your Lord's mercy is far better than whatever wealth they amass.
ayahs.33: Were it not that people might be tempted to become one community of those who reject the truth, We would have supplied the homes of those who reject the Rahman with silver roofs and stairways to ascend,
ayahs.34: as well as silver gates and thrones to recline on,
ayahs.35: and ornaments of gold. Yet all this is no more than fleeting enjoyment in this dunya. The Akhirah with your Lord is only for those who live with taqwa.
ayahs.36: Whoever turns a blind eye to the Reminder of the Rahman, We place at the disposal of each a devilish associate,
ayahs.37: who will certainly hinder them from the Straight Path while they think they are rightly guided.
ayahs.38: But when such a person comes to Us, one will say to their associate: "I wish you were as distant from me as the east is from the west! What an evil associate you were!"
ayahs.39: It will be said to both: "Since you all did wrong, sharing in the punishment will be of no benefit to you this Day."
ayahs.40: Can you make the deaf hear, or guide the blind or those clearly astray?
ayahs.41: Even if We take you away from this world, We will surely inflict punishment upon them.
ayahs.42: Or if We show you what We threaten them with, We certainly have full power over them.
ayahs.43: So hold firmly to what has been revealed to you. You are truly on the Straight Path—the way of living that pleases Allah.
ayahs.44: Surely this Quran is a glory for you and your people. And you will all be questioned about it.
ayahs.45: Ask the followers of the messengers We sent before you if We ever appointed other gods to be worshipped besides the Rahman.
ayahs.46: We sent Musa with Our signs to Pharaoh and his chiefs, and he said: "I am a messenger of the Rabb of all that exists."
ayahs.47: But as soon as he came to them with Our signs, they laughed at them,
ayahs.48: although every sign We showed them was greater than the one before. Ultimately We seized them with torments so that they might return to the Straight Path.
ayahs.49: Then they pleaded: "O mighty sorcerer! Pray to your Lord on our behalf, by virtue of the covenant He made with you. We will certainly accept guidance."
ayahs.50: But as soon as We removed the torments from them, they broke their promise.
ayahs.51: Pharaoh called out to his people, boasting: "O my people, am I not sovereign over Egypt as well as all these streams flowing at my feet? Can you not see?
ayahs.52: Am I not better than this nobody who can hardly express himself?
ayahs.53: Why then have no golden bracelets of kingship been granted to him, or angels come with him as escorts!"
ayahs.54: And so he fooled his people, and they obeyed him. They were truly a rebellious people.
ayahs.55: So when they enraged Us, We inflicted punishment upon them, drowning them all.
ayahs.56: We made them an example and a lesson for those after them.
ayahs.57: When the son of Maryam was cited as an example in argument, your people broke into joyful applause.
ayahs.58: They exclaimed: "Which is better—our gods or 'Isa?" They cite him only to argue. In fact, they are a people prone to dispute.
ayahs.59: He was only a servant We showed favour to and made as an example for the Children of Israel.
ayahs.60: Had We willed, We could have easily replaced you all with angels succeeding one another on earth.
ayahs.61: And his second coming is truly a sign for the Hour. So have no doubt about it, and follow me. This is the Straight Path.
ayahs.62: Do not let Satan hinder you—he is certainly your sworn enemy.
ayahs.63: When 'Isa came with clear proofs, he declared: "I have come to you with wisdom and to clarify to you some of what you differ about. So have taqwa of Allah, and obey me.
ayahs.64: Surely Allah alone is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him alone. This is the Straight Path."
ayahs.65: Yet their various groups have differed among themselves about him, so woe to the wrongdoers when they face the torment of a painful Day!
ayahs.66: Are they waiting for the Hour to take them by surprise when they least expect it?
ayahs.67: Close friends will be enemies to one another on that Day, except the righteous.
ayahs.68: They will be told: "O My servants, there is no fear for you today, nor will you grieve—
ayahs.69: those who believed in Our ayahs and fully submitted to Us.
ayahs.70: Enter Paradise, you and your spouses, rejoicing."
ayahs.71: Golden trays and cups will be passed around to them. There will be whatever the souls desire and the eyes delight in. And you will be there forever.
ayahs.72: That is the Paradise you will be awarded for what you used to do.
ayahs.73: There you will have abundant fruit to eat from.
ayahs.74: Indeed, the wicked will be in the torment of Hell forever.
ayahs.75: It will never be lightened for them, and there they will be overwhelmed with despair.
ayahs.76: We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers.
ayahs.77: They will cry: "O Malik, let your Lord finish us off!" He will answer: "You are definitely here to stay."
ayahs.78: We certainly brought the truth to you, but most of you were resentful of the truth.
ayahs.79: Or have they mastered some evil plan? Then We too are surely planning.
ayahs.80: Or do they think We do not hear their evil thoughts and secret talks? Yes We do! And Our messenger-angels are in their presence, recording it all.
ayahs.81: Say: "If the Rahman really had offspring, I would be the first worshipper."
ayahs.82: Glorified is the Rabb of the heavens and earth, the Rabb of the Throne, far above what they claim.
ayahs.83: So let them indulge in falsehood and amuse themselves until they face their Day, which they have been warned of.
ayahs.84: It is He who is the only deity in the heavens and the only deity on the earth. For He is the All-Wise, All-Knowing.
ayahs.85: Blessed is the One to whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and everything between! With Him alone is the knowledge of the Hour. And to Him you will all be returned.
ayahs.86: Those objects of worship they invoke besides Him have no power to intercede, except those who testify to the truth knowingly.
ayahs.87: If you ask them who created them, they will certainly say, "Allah!" How can they then be deluded from the truth?
ayahs.88: Allah is aware of the Prophet's cry: "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who persist in rejecting the truth."
ayahs.89: So bear with them and respond with peace. They will soon come to know.
